metadata.content:
*A beam of energy connects a foe to a friend, draining life from one to heal the other.*

| **Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike)** |  **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|---------------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**          | **🎯 One enemy** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** 7 + I corruption damage
- **12-16:** 10 + I corruption damage
- **17+:** 15 + I corruption damage

**Effect:** One ally within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) can spend any number of [Recoveries](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries).
